Notes
-----
- Only shotgun and rocket-launcher DSP parameters changed from v4.
- Pistol, Magnum, metralla, Gatling and sniper remain bit-identical by preset parameters.
- No new sound source, filter family, effect or feedback path was introduced.
- Included previews are normalized game audio, not calibrated firearm pressure.
